description: 6 MiB flood: viewer R reads its socket continuously (20 ms timeouts) but sends no CREDIT until the flood ended, then credits; the first 16 KiB after the credit are kept

argv: read -r go; head -c 6291456 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x' | fold -w 99; echo; echo END-OF-FLOOD; sleep 600
terminal.name: flood-credit
